readings.title: Inheritance and Succession
readings.subtitle: The Daughters of Zelophehad and the Appointment of Joshua
readings.text: [Numbers 27:1] And the daughters of Tselophḥaḏ, son of Ḥĕpher, son of Gil’aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashshĕh, of the families of Menashshĕh son of Yoseph, drew near – and these are the names of his daughters: Maḥlah, No’ah, and Ḥog̱lah, and Milkah, and Tirtsah – [2] and stood before Mosheh, and before El’azar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the door of the Tent of Appointment, saying, [3] “Our father died in the wilderness, yet he was not among the company of those who gathered together against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in the company of Qoraḥ, but he died in his own sin and he had no sons. [4] “Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father’s brothers.” [5] So Mosheh brought <dn>את</dn> their case before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [6] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [7] <dq>“The daughters of Tselophḥaḏ speak what is right. You shall certainly give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause <dn>את</dn> the inheritance of their father to pass to them.</dq> [8] <dq>“And speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘When a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to pass to his daughter.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And if he has no daughter, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to his brothers.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And if he has no brothers, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to his father’s brothers.</dq> [11] <dq>‘And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give <dn>את</dn> his inheritance to the next of kin who is closest to him in his family, and he shall possess <dn>את</dn> it.’</dq> And it shall be to the children of Israel a law of right-ruling, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh. [12] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Go up into this mount Aḇarim, and see <dn>את</dn> the land which <dn>I</dn> have given to the children of Israel.</dq> [13] <dq>“And when you have seen <dn>את</dn> it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aharon your brother was gathered,</dq> [14] <dq>because you rebelled against <dn>My</dn> mouth in the Wilderness of Tsin, in the strife of the congregation, to set <dn>Me</dn> apart at the waters before their eyes.”</dq> (These were the waters of Meriḇah, at Qaḏĕsh in the Wilderness of Tsin.) [15] And Mosheh spoke to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, saying, [16] “Let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the <dn>Elohim</dn> of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation, [17] who goes out before them and comes in before them, who leads them out and brings them in, so that the congregation of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be not like sheep which have no shepherd.” [18] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh, <dq>“Take <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Spirit, and you shall lay <dn>את</dn> your hand on him,</dq> [19] <dq>and shall set <dn>את</dn> him before El’azar the priest and before all the congregation, and give <dn>את</dn> him a charge before their eyes,</dq> [20] <dq>and shall put some of your esteem upon him, so that all the congregation of the children of Israel obey.</dq> [21] <dq>“And he is to stand before El’azar the priest, who shall enquire before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for him by the right-ruling of the Urim. At his word they go out, and at his word they come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, all the congregation.”</dq> [22] And Mosheh did as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded him, and took <dn>את</dn> Yehoshua and set him before El’azar the priest and before all the congregation, [23] and laid <dn>את</dn> his hands on him and gave him a charge, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke by the hand of Mosheh.

readings.title: The Appointed Offerings
readings.subtitle: Daily, Sabbath, and Monthly Slaughters
readings.text: [Numbers 28:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Command <dn>את</dn> the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘<dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> offering, <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> food for <dn>My</dn> fire offerings as a sweet fragrance to <dn>Me</dn>, you shall take heed to bring to <dn>Me</dn> at its appointed time.’</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall say to them, ‘This is the fire offering which you bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two male lambs a year old, perfect ones, day by day, a continual burnt offering.</dq> [4] <dq>‘<dn>את</dn> The one lamb you prepare in the morning, and <dn>את</dn> the other lamb you prepare between the evenings,</dq> [5] <dq>and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil –</dq> [6] <dq>a continual burnt offering which was made at Mount Sinai for a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> –</dq> [7] <dq>and its drink offering, one-fourth of a hin for each lamb. Pour out the drink offering of beer to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> in the set-apart place.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And <dn>את</dn> the other lamb you prepare between the evenings. As the morning grain offering and as its drink offering, you prepare it as an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And on the Sabbath day two male lambs a year old, perfect ones, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering –</dq> [10] <dq>the burnt offering for every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.</dq> [11] <dq>‘And on the beginnings of your months you bring a burnt offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, perfect ones;</dq> [12] <dq>and three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;</dq> [13] <dq>and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And their drink offerings: half a hin of wine for a bull, and one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.</dq> [15] <dq>‘And one male goat as a sin offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is prepared, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.’</dq>

readings.title: Festivals of the First Month
readings.subtitle: Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread
readings.text: [Numbers 28:16] <dq>‘And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [17] <dq>‘And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival. For seven days unleavened bread is eaten.</dq> [18] <dq>‘On the first day is a set-apart gathering. You do no servile work.</dq> [19] <dq>‘And you shall bring near an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, perfect ones they should be for you.</dq> [20] <dq>‘And their grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil: prepare three-tenths for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram.</dq> [21] <dq>‘Prepare one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [22] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.</dq> [23] <dq>‘Prepare these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.</dq> [24] <dq>‘According to these you prepare day by day, for seven days, <dn>את</dn> the food of the offering made by fire as a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. It is prepared besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.</dq> [25] <dq>‘And on the seventh day you have a set-apart gathering. You do no servile work.’</dq>

readings.title: The Festival of Weeks
readings.subtitle: The Day of First-Fruits
readings.text: [Numbers 28:26] <dq>‘And on the day of the first-fruits, when you bring a new grain offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at your Festival of Weeks, you have a set-apart gathering. You do no servile work.</dq> [27] <dq>‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering for a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old,</dq> [28] <dq>and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,</dq> [29] <dq>one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [30] <dq>one male goat to make atonement for you,</dq> [31] <dq>perfect ones they should be for you. Prepare them besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, with their drink offerings.’</dq>

readings.title: The Seventh Month Appointments
readings.subtitle: Trumpets, Atonement, and the Start of Booths
readings.text: [Numbers 29:1] <dq>‘And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you have a set-apart gathering. You do no servile work. For you it is a day of blowing the trumpets.</dq> [2] <dq>‘And you shall prepare a burnt offering as a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [3] <dq>and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,</dq> [4] <dq>and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [5] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,</dq> [6] <dq>besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their law, as a sweet fragrance, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [7] <dq>‘And on the tenth day of this seventh month you have a set-apart gathering. And you shall afflict <dn>את</dn> your beings, you do no work.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> as a sweet fragrance: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, perfect ones they should be for you,</dq> [9] <dq>and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,</dq> [10] <dq>one-tenth for each of the seven lambs,</dq> [11] <dq>one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement, the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.’</dq>

readings.title: The Festival of Booths
readings.subtitle: The Eight Days of Sukkot
readings.text: [Numbers 29:12] <dq>‘And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month you have a set-apart gathering. You do no servile work, and you shall celebrate a festival to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> for seven days.</dq> [13] <dq>‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones they should be,</dq> [14] <dq>and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams,</dq> [15] <dq>and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs,</dq> [16] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [17] <dq>‘And on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [18] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [19] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.</dq> [20] <dq>‘And on the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [21] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [22] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering with its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [23] <dq>‘And on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [24] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [25] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [26] <dq>‘And on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [27] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [28] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [29] <dq>‘And on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [30] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [31] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [32] <dq>‘And on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [33] <dq>and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [34] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [35] <dq>‘On the eighth day you have an assembly. You do no servile work.</dq> [36] <dq>‘And you shall bring near a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, perfect ones,</dq> [37] <dq>their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the law,</dq> [38] <dq>and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.</dq> [39] <dq>‘<dn>את</dn> These you prepare for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at your appointed times, besides your vowed offerings and your voluntary offerings, as your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, and your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’</dq> [40] And Mosheh spoke to the children of Israel according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh.
